Maybe via a mutating admission (default tolerations injected by something) — or the pod tolerations are injected. Let's check the running pod's tolerations via DescribeResource on cartservice pod.

Actually the describe for adservice pod showed Tolerations: only not-ready/unreachable NoExecute 300s (default). No critical=true toleration. So adservice pod lacks the toleration. Let's check cartservice pod describe to see if it has critical=true toleration — then the difference is a per-pod injected toleration... but both YAMLs lack tolerations. Hmm, maybe the snapshot's GetAppYAML trims tolerations? Let's check another pod, e.g. productcatalogservice pod describe, to see tolerations.

Alternatively, maybe the taint was added recently and existing pods were scheduled before the taint (taints added after pods already running) — pods already running aren't evicted (NoSchedule doesn't evict). Then a new pod (adservice) fails. In that case the "root cause" would be the taint on all workers = taint_toleration_mismatch still, victim app adservice... but wait, if the taint is cluster-wide newly added, then ALL new pods would fail — but others are running (created at the same time, ~73s). All pods are ~71-73s old, i.e., all created at the same time. adservice failed to schedule while others succeeded. So the others must have tolerated. So toleration must be present somewhere — maybe in a pod-level injected config. Let's check pod describe for cartservice.

Hmm, but adservice pod describe showed only default tolerations. If all pods have default tolerations only, then all would fail. Unless... adservice's missing toleration is what distinguishes. Let me check the cartservice pod's tolerations to be sure.

Also possible the master node's unschedulable + taints. Let's describe worker nodes to see taints, and describe cartservice pod.

Let me also consider: maybe the actual injected fault is node_cordon_mismatch: master cordoned (unschedulable). But only 1 of 4 nodes; workers tainted. Hmm.

Actually, let's reconsider. Explanation: worker nodes have taint critical=true:NoSchedule. Pods with a toleration for it run there. The adservice deployment... let's check the actual live pod spec of a running pod. Do GetResources(pods, name=cartservice-..., output_wide)? Better: DescribeResource pod cartservice pod.
